why_microsoft_is_not_the_failsafe: Microsoft is identity, notify, SoR, and host. It sells the models that draft the write. An independent plane must sit over those models. A Copilot feature, PIM activation, or Teams vote is not dual admit.
why_ultimate_plane: Ultimate means last authority before the write, over every AI that can draft one — not ownership of every model. The vendor of the drafting AI cannot credibly be that failsafe. A vendor-native button only covers that vendor. One admit plane over the whole estate is the insulation. This is not a patent. This is not uncopyable.
